global_style: Minimalist corporate presentation utilizing wide geometric typography, continuous organic line motifs, and striking diagonal image masks in a yellow and gray palette.

identity_anchors: Continuous, intersecting organic yellow wavy line spanning across slides.
Sharp diagonal divisions and V-shaped masks for imagery.
Persistent vertical tracking text along the right margin.
Circular motifs including solid yellow dots, gray rings, and circular image crops.

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
